text:
Alex: Heads up — we're seeing a new spike of 'action_hook parse error' rejects in the structured-output validator for the canary model-variant. Not sure if it's noise or a legit change.
Mira: Ugh, saw that in the dashboard too. Which route is this happening on?
Alex: Mostly on /chat/stream and a few Dedicated routes. Error rates jumped ~6% over the last 30m.
Sam: Can you paste the validator log sample?
Alex: ```
ValidationError: action_hook.parse - missing field 'items'
payload: {"action": "create_ticket", "params": {"summary":"..."}}
expected schema: {"action": string, "items": [{...}]}
```
Mira: Looks like model omitted an array when clients expect items[]. Could be prompt template drift or a model output change after latest compile.
Olivia: Is this failing billing/quotas or just flagged? We need to decide whether to count these as rejects for quota accounting.
Sam: Current pipeline marks schema-rejects as non-billable, but our billing mapping uses 'reject -> rate-limited path' for some internal customers, which confused alerts.
Alex: For canary we aren't charging, but the console shows 'rejects' as traffic that bumps strictness meters. Ops is getting paged.
Mira: Two things we should consider: (1) sample these reject payloads more (higher telemetry retention) for a golden prompt set; (2) add a dashboard split for 'action_hook missing-array' so engineers can triage quickly.
Olivia: Agreed. Also we need UX for rollouts: if canary has >5% structural change, auto-pause and notify owners. Right now console only shows raw % but no gating.
Sam: On telemetry sampling: suggest attaching a deterministic sampler keyed by customer+route so we don't blow up retention but still get representative hits. We already do similar for latency traces.
Alex: Can we add a quick hotfix: when schema rejects spike, tag them as 'soft-invalid' in console so they don't trigger pager until human triage?
Mira: Prefer a short-term patch: set an incident suppression window for the canary route and create a 'validation spike' alert that hits paging only if other signs (error traces, downstream failures) also present.
ConsoleBot: New dashboard request created: /dash/eng-platform/actionhook-parse-noise (owner: Mira).
infra-bot: Deployed sampler rule 'deterministic-actionhook-sample' to telemetry-prod (rate: 5%).
Olivia: Thanks. Action items: Mira to add dashboard split + alert tweak, Sam to roll deterministic sampler to 10% if we need more samples, Alex to collect 200 sample payloads and put in #eng-platform thread, and I'll draft a gating proposal for canary auto-pause.
Sam: I'll monitor billing mapping — ensure these remain non-billable.
Mira: I'll also add a one-line tooltip in console explaining 'soft-invalid' vs 'hard-reject' so support knows what's going on.
Alex: I'll upload the sample payloads in 30m. Ping me if you need quick access. :thumbsup:
Olivia: Cool. If spike persists after samples, consider rolling back the model variant.
Sam: Noted.
Alex: thanks all — will report back with samples.
